description:
Upgrade, renew or switch the signed-in user's plan without the website. Card: returns a secure Square
payment link (or, for an active card subscriber, switches the plan right away). Crypto: returns the exact amount,
coin, network and address to send. The plan activates automatically when paid. Free to call. Requires the user's
personal connection address; on the public preview use start_signup instead.

payment_method.description: 'card' (monthly renews automatically), 'wallet' (Apple Pay / Google Pay / Cash App, one-time) or 'crypto' (one-time).
